Changed how reviving downed players works to fix griefing/trolling by attackers who just tap E on you to reset the timer, preventing you from dying or getting up and forcing you to F1 -> Kill.
* Starting to revive another player no longer resets their wounded timer
* If the wounded timer runs out mid-hold you can't die or get up until E is let go - a full revive hold still goes through

Made procgen naked beach spawns fairer to cover more areas of beach with less strict checks
* Also fixes party spawns not working on first spawn; reset pooled team spawn state
* Reduced monument check from 50m to 30m using painted topology, not boxes
* Allow spawning on jungle/desert coastline if it is 50m away from temperate/tundra
* Don't block spawning near swamps, substations or caves
* Fairer weighting so smaller beaches see more spawns (sqrt of area rather than just area)
* Opened up more coastline to spawning by allowing spawn within 5m of Oceanside texels
* Skip spawnpoints that are >0.5 underwater (fixes existing rare bugs)
